## Summary
**Stage A** of P0.15d (offline, no spend, PR-able) — finishes what P0.15c's live execution *started but could not complete*. It closes the **coding half** of the three live blockers P0.15c surfaced (`DEFERRALS` D-P0.15c-6/7/8) and wires the phase-loop credit renderer. **Stage B** (live re-deploy + paid Reviews) stays **[OPERATOR GATE]d** — no budget was stated this session (the operator's concurrent commit `ac0cba8` confirms budget is stated when Stage B begins). Stacked on P0.15c (PR #19).

## What changed
- **The server-authored run spec (D-P0.15c-6 — the load-bearing item).** `@rhema/orchestrator/runspec.ts` `buildHarnessRunSpec` assembles the full `HarnessRunSpec` from server-side facts; the api serves it token-authed at `GET /internal/runs/:id/runspec`; `apps/run-task/harness-main.ts` **fetches** it (file fallback) instead of reading the unbuilt `RUN_SPEC_FILE`. It carries the `PhaseRequest` (the workflow manifest's current phase — or an explicit `phase:"N"` pin — + the frozen inputs), `skillsDir`, `tier`, the hydration `manifest` + derived `serverFiles` bytes, and a **JSON-safe** `hookPolicyInput` (the harness compiles the `SeatPolicy` + a fresh `DenialState` locally — `Set`/`Map` don't survive JSON). `@rhema/mirror` `buildSeatHydration` returns the derived `manifest.md`/`obligations.json` bytes from the *same* `resolveSeatTree` pass, so each byte-blob's sha matches its manifest entry (no drift). The launcher injects `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`; the Dockerfile bakes skills at `/app/skills`.
- **Sandbox node egress + pod NetworkPolicy in the IaC (D-P0.15c-8).** `network.ts`: the Private-Google-Access route (`199.36.153.8/30` → gateway) + sandbox node-egress firewalls (VIP + GKE master) + private DNS zones. `iam.ts`: the run-task GSA gets `roles/artifactregistry.reader`. `compute.ts`: dataplane-v2 (`ADVANCED_DATAPATH`) + explicit `ipAllocationPolicy` (VPC-native). `infra/k8s/`: the `runs` namespace, WI-bound `run-task-ksa`, and the pod egress NetworkPolicy + a documented `apply.sh`.
- **Egress-proxy MIG re-platform (D-P0.15c-7).** `compute.ts` replaces the discontinued COS `gce-container-declaration` with a startup-script `docker run` MIG (`proxy.ts`, unit-tested); ungated so a plain `pulumi up` stands it up.
- **Phase loop (item 4).** `rateTableCreditRenderer` wired into the `runPhase` composition — which surfaced and **fixed a real bug** (fractional renderer credits written into the `int` `usage_records.credits` column → `Math.round`). `reDebitOnResume` confirmed already wired.

## Design decisions
- **api owns assembly, harness fetches** (§12.6 "attestation derives only from server-side facts"): a token-gated fetch, not a mounted Secret. The compiled `SeatPolicy` (a `Set`) and `DenialState` (a `Map`) aren't JSON-serializable, so the wire carries JSON-safe compile *inputs* and the harness recompiles with the same `@rhema/hooks` code — keeping policy server-authored without shipping an unserializable object.
- **Pod NetworkPolicy denies *arbitrary-internet* egress**, not all egress: the *harness* uid legitimately needs GCS (materialize `/work`) + the internal api; only the *agent* uid is confined to the proxy (by its scrubbed env + the two-uid boundary). The policy allows kube-dns + the proxy tier + the PGA VIP and denies the rest.
